fields.name: abi_version
fields.doc: Fixed 1 for this schema. A core that finds an unrecognized version halts/faults rather than misreading the layout.

fields.name: struct_size
fields.doc: Bytes of the config block actually in use; lets a future larger struct coexist with an older reader of the same major version.

fields.name: requested_generation
fields.doc: Written last by the config-writer when committing a staged change. The single 'something changed' signal.

fields.name: pru0_ack_generation
fields.doc: PRU0 (emulator) writes this equal to requested_generation once it has applied it.

fields.name: pru1_ack_generation
fields.doc: PRU1 (reader) writes this equal to requested_generation once it has applied it.

fields.name: topology
fields.doc: 0=loopback (PRU0 emulator + PRU1 reader both active, PRU1 waits for PRU0's ack), 1=reader-only (PRU1 only; PRU0 ack is skipped).

fields.name: encoding_type
fields.doc: 0=binary, 1=gray, 2=gray-excess, 3=tannenbaum. Informational for PRU1's decode step; PRU0 never encodes.

fields.name: alignment
fields.doc: 0=left-justified (position starts at frame bit 0, MSB-first), 1=right-justified (position ends at the last clock, per family docs).

fields.name: formation_mode
fields.doc: 0=asynchronous, 1=synchronous position formation.

fields.name: frame_width_bits
fields.doc: Total bits clocked per frame. 1..64.

fields.name: position_offset_bits
fields.doc: Bit offset of the position field from the frame's first clock.

fields.name: position_width_bits
fields.doc: Total position bits (singleturn + multiturn).

fields.name: singleturn_width_bits
fields.doc: Singleturn portion of position_width_bits.

fields.name: multiturn_width_bits
fields.doc: Multiturn portion; 0 for singleturn-only families.

fields.name: error_offset_bits
fields.doc: Bit offset of the error/status field; 0xFFFF if none.

fields.name: error_width_bits
fields.doc: Error/status bit count.

fields.name: padding_width_bits
fields.doc: Zero-fill bits when resolution is below the allocated width.

fields.name: clock_high_cycles
fields.doc: Single-loop iterations the SSI clock line stays high per bit (<=256).

fields.name: clock_low_cycles
fields.doc: Single-loop iterations the SSI clock line stays low per bit (<=256).

fields.name: sample_delay_cycles
fields.doc: Reader: single-loop iterations after the rising edge before sampling data (<=256, and < clock_high_cycles).

fields.name: tv_cycles
fields.doc: Emulator: single-loop iterations after the clock edge before data is valid (datasheet tv, <=256).

fields.name: tm_pause_outer_iters
fields.doc: Outer-loop count (x fixed inner 250) for the monoflop / inter-frame idle time the emulator holds before accepting a new frame.

fields.name: tp_pause_outer_iters
fields.doc: Outer-loop count (x fixed inner 250) for the reader's inter-frame gap; must be > tm_pause_outer_iters.

fields.name: formation_pause_outer_iters
fields.doc: Outer-loop count (x fixed inner 250). Sync mode: delay from clock-train end to position latch. Async mode: refresh interval.

fields.name: sequence_hold_mode
fields.doc: 0=hold each sequence value for a frame count, 1=hold for a time duration.

fields.name: fault_mode
fields.doc: 0=none, 1=status/error bits, 2=sentinel value, 3=all-ones, 4=missing response, 5=shortened frame, 6=excessive tv, 7=data stuck low, 8=data stuck high.

fields.name: capture_mode
fields.doc: 0=off, 1=latest-sample only, 2=latest-sample + trace.

fields.name: _reserved0
fields.doc: Reserved.

fields.name: sequence_hold_count
fields.doc: Frames (mode 0) or PRU cycles (mode 1) to hold each sequence value.

fields.name: fault_argument
fields.doc: Mode-specific: sentinel value, stuck-pin level, etc.

fields.name: fault_repeat_count
fields.doc: Frames the fault persists before auto-reverting to valid operation; 0=until reconfigured.

fields.name: _reserved1
fields.doc: Reserved; zero-filled. Future fields land here without moving anything else.

fields.name: frame_bits
fields.doc: Raw wire value, right-aligned; PRU0 shifts out its low frame_width_bits bits, MSB-first. Already Gray/Tannenbaum/aligned/padded by the config-writer.

fields.name: hold_override_cycles_or_frames
fields.doc: 0 means 'use the config block's sequence_hold_count'; nonzero overrides it for this slot only.

fields.name: _reserved0
fields.doc: Reserved.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: Odd while being written, even and stable when readable. Consumers retry while odd or while it changed mid-read.

fields.name: raw_frame
fields.doc: Exactly what was clocked in, right-aligned.

fields.name: position_value
fields.doc: The position field's raw bits, structurally extracted at position_offset_bits/position_width_bits, zero-extended. Still wire-encoded (Gray/Tannenbaum, if any); PRU1 only ever does offset/width bit extraction.

fields.name: status_bits
fields.doc: Error/status field, zero-extended, 0 if error_width_bits == 0.

fields.name: frame_counter
fields.doc: Monotonic count of frames received.

fields.name: timestamp_cycles
fields.doc: PRU cycle counter at frame completion (wide to avoid wraparound over a long run).

fields.name: _reserved0
fields.doc: Reserved.

fields.name: trace_write_index
fields.doc: Monotonic; current slot is trace_write_index % 1024.

fields.name: trace_overrun_count
fields.doc: Incremented once per write once trace_write_index >= 1024 (i.e. every write that overwrites a not-yet-read slot).

fields.name: _reserved0
fields.doc: Reserved.

fields.name: timestamp_cycles
fields.doc: PRU cycle counter at frame completion.

fields.name: raw_frame
fields.doc: Exactly what was clocked in, right-aligned.

fields.name: position_value
fields.doc: Structurally extracted position field, zero-extended, still wire-encoded.

fields.name: status_bits
fields.doc: Error/status field, zero-extended.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0 = fault active.

fields.name: _reserved0
fields.doc: Reserved.
